attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Trejhara Solutions Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by Crisil Ratings Limited. The report concerns the utilization of proceeds from a Preferential Issue of Equity Shares and Convertible Warrants totaling Rs 162.17 crore. The issue period was from January 27, 2026, to February 10, 2026. The company has utilized Rs 50.44 crore, primarily for strategic acquisitions. Rs 111.73 crore remains unutilized as it is yet to be received from warrant holders. The report notes that the warrant conversion price of Rs 162.00 per share is higher than the closing market price of Rs 124.05 per share on October 15, 2026, posing a risk of non-exercise of conversion rights. The report was reviewed by the Audit Committee and Board of Directors on November 6, 2026.

attchmntText: TREJHARA SOLUTIONS LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication for Un-audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Trejhara Solutions Limited published un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, via newspaper advertisements in Financial Express and Loksatta on November 07, 2025. The announcement includes detailed financial data for Trejhara Solutions Limited. Additionally, the document contains un-audited financial results for Transworld Shipping Lines Limited for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, which were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors on November 06, 2026. The text also includes unrelated financial advertisements for Godrej Agrovet Limited and Muthoot Microfin Limited.

attchmntText: TREJHARA SOLUTIONS LIMITED has submitted to the Exchange, the Unaudited financial results for the Second quarter and Half year ended September 30, 2026.
